highlights: OpenAI's latest GPT-6 models, including Astra, Sol, and Luna, are driving significant enterprise efficiency gains and expanding capabilities with balanced cost options for builders.
The AI industry demonstrates a strong commitment to practical skills development and responsible AI, with new training programs and robust safety benchmarks emerging to foster ethical innovation.

Advancements in developer tools and infrastructure, such as improved prompt caching, accelerated robotics simulation, and efficient LLM quantization, are enhancing builder productivity and model performance.

agents.title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
agents.summary: Ringg leverages OpenAI's GPT-5.6 to power multilingual customer service agents across various channels, achieving up to 65% call resolution and 90% cost reduction compared to previous models, demonstrating significant operational efficiency.

agents.title: Your Agent Aced the Task. Will It Do It Again?
agents.summary: This article from IBM Research explores the crucial challenge of ensuring consistency in AI agent performance, highlighting the need for robust evaluation methods beyond single successful runs to build reliable agentic systems.

agents.title: Give Your Coding Agents a Memory You Own
agents.summary: This development focuses on equipping coding agents with persistent, owned memory, enabling them to retain context and learn from past interactions for more efficient and customized performance in complex development workflows.

models.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
models.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two new frontier models designed to bring advanced intelligence to everyday tasks, offering developers flexible choices with different balances of capability and cost for diverse applications.

models.title: Introducing MentalHealthBench
models.summary: OpenAI introduces MentalHealthBench, an expert-informed benchmark to rigorously evaluate AI responses in realistic mental health conversations, ensuring helpfulness and safety for models deployed in sensitive applications.

models.title: NeoMME: an efficient Multimodal-native and Multilingual Encoder
models.summary: H Company unveils NeoMME, an efficient multimodal-native and multilingual encoder designed to process diverse data types and languages simultaneously, offering improved performance and broader applicability for global AI solutions.

tools.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
tools.summary: OpenAI has enhanced prompt caching for GPT-6, providing developers with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, and explicit controls to significantly reduce latency and operational costs for repetitive LLM interactions.

tools.title: Transformers now runs llama.cpp quants
tools.summary: The Hugging Face Transformers library now supports llama.cpp quantization, enabling developers to run highly optimized and efficient versions of large language models directly within the popular framework for reduced memory footprint and faster inference.

tools.title: How to Use NVIDIA Warp and MjWarp to Accelerate Robotics Simulation and Learning Workflows
tools.summary: This guide demonstrates how to leverage NVIDIA Warp and MjWarp to dramatically accelerate robotics simulation and learning workflows, offering builders powerful tools for faster iteration and more complex robotic system development.

companies.title: Proaction boosts sales 60% and saves 75+ hours with Codex
companies.summary: Proaction significantly improved fleet management operations by integrating OpenAI's Codex, GPT-Live-1, and GPT-6 Astra, leading to a 60% sales increase and saving over 75 hours in development and operational time.

companies.title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
companies.summary: Harvey, a legal tech firm, is leveraging OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to generate more structured and context-aware legal documents, empowering lawyers to concentrate on strategic tasks by streamlining the drafting process.

companies.title: Airbnb widens access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models
companies.summary: Airbnb is expanding internal access to GPT-6 Astra and other OpenAI frontier models, enabling engineering teams to accelerate bug resolution, improve system design, and ship products faster across their development cycles.

learning.title: DevFest is back
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 returns with over 800 global events, offering developers an opportunity to connect, build, secure, and scale applications in the agentic AI era through practical workshops and community engagement.

learning.title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
learning.summary: OpenAI and Grab are collaborating on 'GO Forward with AI,' a regional program aiming to equip 30,000 partners across Southeast Asia with practical AI skills, fostering a new generation of AI-literate professionals.

learning.title: Two years of OpenAI Academy
learning.summary: OpenAI celebrates two years of its Academy, emphasizing its continued commitment to bringing essential AI skills to diverse communities and expanding access to high-quality AI education for aspiring builders.
